### EQ001 — Physical thermal state and Fermi-Dirac occupation

*Defines every physical single-mode state and the complete Figure 1 curve.*

$$
\rho=(1-\langle n\rangle)aa^\dagger+\langle n\rangle a^\dagger a=(1+e^\nu)^{-1}e^{\nu a^\dagger a},\quad \langle n\rangle=(1+e^{\epsilon/T})^{-1}
$$

### EQ002 — Glauber P, Wigner W, and Husimi Q supernumbers

*Provides the common Grassmann soul and the three bodies feeding all disorder measures.*

$$
P=-\langle n\rangle+\alpha\alpha^*,\quad W=1/2-\langle n\rangle+\alpha\alpha^*,\quad Q=1-\langle n\rangle+\alpha\alpha^*
$$

$$
